independentValidation.method: Strict declaration consumer coverage and independently executed pinned JavaScript versus built TypeScript comparison of all 15 geotechnical public constants through both root and domain barrels, exact JSON values and Unicode code points, with pinned repository cleanliness checks.

parityDifferences: The target already exposes these constants through strict TypeScript modules and public barrels; this bounded slice adds direct provenance and independent parity evidence without changing runtime values.

The domain geotechnics barrel remains partial for the three source axial-capacity exports whose accepted target implementation is in the norms layer; importing norms from domain would violate the architecture boundary.
